app TypedDurableSend
use std {EmailV1 as Mail} from=deployment.mail
Given
 Entry { count:int=0 }
 policy Entry read=public
When
 crud Entry by=owner fields=count
 ## The request and row update share one commit; a later refusal drops both.
 scenario deliver(entry:Entry,to:email,accept:bool) -> int by=owner
  do
   set entry {count=entry.count+1}
   send Mail.send {to=to,subject="Actual send",body="Durable request"} as attempt
   require accept
   return entry.count
Then
